fusions.name: Reeking Spray
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health to spray a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage, with a 50% chance to leave each target [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lingering Pellet
fusions.desc: Flings a musk pellet up to 6 tiles that deals 11 damage, up to 1.2 times as much at full reach, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Warning Stripes
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds, and forces up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles to attack you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Clinging Reek
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. Your armour rises by 6%, and you have 10% poison resistance.
